Allahabad High Court dismisses UP Cricket Association's asset transfer plea

The Allahabad High Court has dismissed a petition filed by the Cricket Association of Uttar Pradesh (CAUP). The CAUP had sought the transfer of all assets belonging to the Uttar Pradesh Cricket Association (UPCA) to itself. The court also refused to order a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the BCCI's financial connections with the UPCA. The specific details of the court's reasoning for dismissal were not provided in the coverage.
